title: Open a position with a market order
description: Web Terminal block (testnet): reload the order page (Reduce only and TWAP start unticked; the market is checked), require no position in the market, place a market order on the requested side with TP and SL set at entry or explicitly cleared (the form keeps them per market), confirm the agent approval when it is the first write, and prove the venue position and its triggers (two reduce-only triggers, or none). Leaves the position open; the caller closes or cleans.

fresh_page.intent: Start the market order from a freshly loaded order form

no_position.intent: Require no position in the market, so the fill check can only see this order

tab_market.intent: Switch the order form to a market order

enter_size.intent: Enter how many dollars the trader commits

boxes_off.intent: Confirm TWAP and Reduce only start unticked

tpsl.intent: Attach the requested TP/SL to the order, or clear any the form kept

choose_approve.intent: Confirm the agent approval only on the session's first write

approve.intent: Approve the trading agent in MetaMask the first time the trader writes to the venue

position_open.intent: Prove the market order filled into a position on the requested side

position_proof.intent: Bind the proof to the venue read: one position on the requested side

choose_tpsl_check.intent: Check the triggers that were attached, or that none were

no_triggers.intent: Prove the order opened the position with no TP or SL

no_triggers_proof.intent: Bind the proof to the venue read: no trigger order on the market

tp_at_entry.intent: Prove one reduce-only take profit rests at the entry TP price

sl_at_entry.intent: Prove one reduce-only stop loss rests at the entry SL price

tpsl_proof.intent: Bind the proof to the venue read: one stop loss at the entry price (the take profit was asserted just before)

capture.label: order-market-{{params.side}}
capture.intent: Keep a picture of the order page with the new position

signer.description: extension: the real MetaMask extension confirms every wallet request (acceptance mode). injected: the strict test wallet signs in the harness (fast mode).

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for this slot (dev1 on mmt-1, Trading on mmt-2).

market.description: Testnet market reserved for this run.

notional.description: Order amount in USD typed into the order form; at least the venue minimum.

take_profit.description: Take-profit trigger price set at entry; empty for none. Set together with stop_loss.

stop_loss.description: Stop-loss trigger price set at entry; empty for none. Set together with take_profit.

approve_agent.description: true when this submit is the session's first write: confirm the one ApproveAgent request (MetaMask in extension mode) before the venue check.
